name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Extension (SMAE)
benefit:
Farmers are periodically trained in modern agricultural practices. Agricultural exhibitions, fairs, and farmer seminars are organized, and farmers are also taken on exposure visits to enhance their knowledge and skills. Additionally, farmer–scientist interactions are conducted to facilitate the exchange of ideas and innovations.
**Farm School:** Free seeds, fertilizers, and chemicals are provided
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must have cultivable land. 1. The farmer’s name must be duly registered in the relevant land records.
